onlyKnownAt: Weekly Sunday UTC close; no future price allowed for stage classification. Future classification changes are reported as outcomes, not used for features.
episodeDefinition: An entry event at Sunday t iff category differs from immediately previous Sunday. Each uninterrupted same-category spell counted once, with its actual duration until next switch. First eligible Sunday is left-censored and NOT treated as an entry. Short entries still counted; any later repeated narrow entry another event (sensitivity via 13w gap).

analysis.leadLag: For each NARROW entry, seek next BROAD entry in 4w, 13w and 26w. Also report first exit from NARROW, its destination and week lag, and whether NOT_CONFIRMED arrived before BROAD within horizon. Unknown breadth treated as censoring for claims about BROAD absence.
analysis.baseline: Compare observed NARROW entry pathways to corresponding BROAD and NOT_CONFIRMED entry episodes, tabulating 13w BTC price outcomes and 13w max adverse close change.
analysis.horizonOnly: 4, 13, 26 weeks for category transitions; 4,13,26 week returns from v8.3 unchanged. More distant 52 week not primary.
analysis.censor: If window extends beyond 2026-10-11, report RIGHT_CENSORED. Partial observations do NOT count as absent transitions. For ambiguous UNKNOWN weekly, report DATA_CENSORED_BREADTH.
analysis.sensitivity: For NARROW entries, report 13-week spaced selected events (greedy earliest event then skip any entry within 13 weeks after selected). This is date-anchor dependent, exploratory, not independent draws.
analysis.temporal: Split 2020-2023 versus 2024-2026. Track raw counts, positive future returns and medians, no OOS accuracy claims.

externalContext.ETF: US spot BTC ETF launched January 2024. Current/historical Farside table shows eventual revised daily net flows but exact publication time and revisions not reconstructible merely from current page; assign CURRENT_CONTEXT or PIT_UNVERIFIED; no historical predictive scoring.
externalContext.liquidity: Fed H.4.1 Thursdays 4:30pm ET, weekly observations refer to preceding Wednesday; preserving available_at is essential; a current H.4.1 level not complete net liquidity (TGA, RRP, reserves must be reconciled). Do not insert fabricated historical liquidity vintage.
externalContext.requirement: No join to historical transition returns unless source dataset has timestamped releases and revisions, source hash, missingness / PIT documented.

sampleGate: If fewer than 20 distinct NARROW episodes or fewer than 10 episodes per era, classify descriptive only/no probabilities. Do not claim recurring BTC lead without non-overlapping inter-cycle independent support.
integrity: no changed 2026-10-11 last weekly row or 321 weekly rows
prohibited: No modifications to portfolio, NAV, Spot, Futures, orders, reserve, leverage, trade limits or MASTER
No predictions or probability from retrospective event counts
